teacher.summary: The model is the cheerful teacher with glasses, a mustard cardigan, a blue bow, a pointer, and a red apple. The outfit and face match the mockup, but the hair has a clearly different shape and texture.
strengths: The round glasses, the large brown eyes, the smile, and the pink cheeks read as the mockup face.
The mustard cardigan, the white collar, the blue bow, and the brown skirt match the mockup palette.
The raised pointer and the red apple read clearly in the 128 px sprites.
issues: The hair is a lumpy mass with dripping ridges. The mockup hair is smooth and wavy, with side-swept bangs. Make the hair surface smooth and add the bangs across the forehead.
From the back, the hair reads as thick dreadlocks to the shoulders. Shape the back of the hair as one smooth wavy volume.
The side braid hangs on the pointer side (viewer's left). In the mockup, the braid hangs on the apple side (viewer's right). Move the braid to the other side.
The pointer is thicker than the thin mockup stick. Make the pointer thinner.
In the walk, the arms stay still and the body moves very little. This is a known base limit.
teacher.next: Rebuild the hair as a smooth wavy bob with side-swept bangs.

cartographer.summary: The model is the old cartographer with round glasses, a white beard, a green coat, raised dividers, and a bundle of maps. The face and the props match, but the coat, the dividers, and the head have clear differences.
strengths: The round black glasses, the white beard, and the bald head read clearly in every view and at 128 px.
The green coat, the brown vest with gold buttons, and the tied map bundle match the mockup palette.
The raised arm with the dividers gives a strong, readable silhouette.
issues: The green coat flares to the knees like a robe. In the mockup, the jacket stops at the hips and shows the belt, the buckle, and brown trousers. Shorten the coat and show the belt and the trousers.
The dividers are thin and small, like a fork. The mockup dividers are large and broad brass. Make the dividers larger and wider.
The head has no white quiff on top, and the nose is small. The mockup has a tall white quiff and a large red nose. Add the quiff and make the nose larger and redder.
From the back, a flat skin-colored block shows under the hair ring. Round the back of the head below the hair.
The walk shows almost no visible leg motion under the long coat.
cartographer.next: Shorten the coat to the hips and show the belt and the brown trousers.

nomad.summary: The model is the young desert wanderer with goggles, a cream scarf, an orange coat, a bedroll, and a staff with a bell. The face and the staff match, but the coat, the bedroll, and the skin tone have clear differences.
strengths: The goggles on the curly hair, the smile, and the pink cheeks read as a cheerful young traveler.
The crook staff with the brass bell matches the mockup and reads clearly in every sprite direction.
The cream scarf and the orange coat with the brown belt match the mockup palette.
issues: The coat is short, closed, and flares like a skirt. In the mockup, the long coat hangs open to the calves and shows beige trousers. Make the coat longer and open, and show the beige trousers.
The bedroll is a flat disc with a gold face. From the back and the side, it reads as a shield or a drum. Make it a rolled cloth cylinder with straps.
The skin is darker than the warm brown skin in the mockup. Make the skin tone lighter.
The hair is a short mop. The mockup hair is longer and falls to the shoulders. Make the hair longer at the sides.
In the walk, the arms stay still and the body moves very little. This is a known base limit.
nomad.next: Make the coat long and open over beige trousers, and make the bedroll a rolled cylinder.

hermit.summary: The model is the kind old hermit with pointed ears, a long white beard, a brown hooded robe, a gnarled stick, and a bowl of berries. It is close to the mockup, but the white hair tuft goes through the top of the hood.
strengths: The pointed ears, the bushy white eyebrows, the round nose, and the long beard match the mockup face.
The gnarled stick and the bowl of red berries read clearly in every view and at 128 px.
The brown robe with the green sash, the rope belt, the pouch, the patches, and the sandals match the mockup.
issues: The white hair tuft sits on top of the hood dome and goes through the fabric. In the mockup, the tuft rises from the forehead at the open front of the hood. Move the tuft to the front hairline, inside the hood opening.
The hood is a tight round dome like a cap. The mockup hood is soft, frames the face, and drapes onto the shoulders. Give the hood a front rim and let it fall onto the shoulders.
The beard hides the mouth, so the smile does not show. The mockup shows a smile under the mustache. Add a small smiling mouth under the mustache.
The stance is narrow and the robe sleeves are tight. The mockup has a wide stance and wide sleeves. Widen the sleeves at the wrists.
In the walk, the arms stay still and the body moves very little. This is a known base limit.
hermit.next: Move the white tuft out of the hood dome to the front hairline.

ranger-guide.summary: The model is the confident young ranger guide in a green hood and cloak, with a brass compass, a staff, a longbow, and a quiver. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The green hood, the brown hair with bangs, and the smiling face read as the mockup character.
The brass compass in the raised hand is a clear focal accent against the green cloak.
The longbow and the quiver on the back give a clear role read from the back and in the sprites.
issues: The hood is a round dome with a lumpy surface. The mockup hood is smooth, with a soft peak at the back. Make the hood surface smooth and give it a soft peak.
The braid is a chain of round balls. Shape the braid as woven, overlapping segments.
The cloak is shorter than the mockup cloak, which falls to the calves. Make the cloak longer.
The eyebrows are thick and dark. The mockup eyebrows are thin and arched. Make the eyebrows thinner.
In the walk, the arms stay still and the body moves very little. This is a known base limit.
ranger-guide.next: Make the hood smooth with a soft peak, and shape the braid as woven segments.
